subject: Pricing follow-up: token benchmarking & target price
messages:
From: Jared Simmons <jared.simmons@acme.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 13:15:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing follow-up: token benchmarking & target price

Thanks again for the call earlier — good to meet you, Vanessa. As discussed, I'm sending over a high-level usage profile and a few clarifying questions to help your team size a realistic pilot/PoC.

Quick context:
- Current production traffic: ~10M tokens/month today (mainly generation with context windows up to 4k). Peak tests hit ~40M tokens/month.
- Token mix: ~80% generation, ~20% embeddings/rerank.
- Key goal: get predictable unit economics to plan Q3 budget.

Immediate asks from our side:
1) Can Redwood hit a target price in the $6–8 per 1M tokens range at 20–40M/mo?
2) For benchmarking, please show $/1M comparisons vs OpenAI, Anthropic, and typical managed open-model hosts (assume equivalent quality latency SLA).
3) Any assumptions on batching, quantization, and dedicated capacity needed to get to target price?

Attached: acme-usage-profile-q1-2027.csv (CSV with month-by-month token counts and sample prompt mix).

Next steps: we'd like a short SOW and a scope for a 2-week PoC (baseline performance + cost numbers). Our procurement would prefer an estimate that maps to a committed monthly spend if numbers look good.

Thanks,
Jared
Director, AI Platforms
Acme Corp
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Jared Simmons <jared.simmons@acme.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@acme.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up: token benchmarking & target price

Jared — great to meet you on the call. Appreciate the usage file. High-level recap and next steps below so we're aligned.

Recap from call:
- Target PoC: 2 weeks, focus on gen latency and token-cost baseline.
- Volume band for planning: 10–40M tokens/mo (we should size for 40M to be safe).
- Target price band: your ask $6–8/1M tokens.

What we'll deliver for the PoC:
- Baseline throughput/latency numbers for your workload on our curated open-models.
- $/1M token cost estimate under hosted and dedicated (committed) deployments.
- Actionable optimizations: batching/kv cache/quantization settings to hit target economics if possible.

Initial note on benchmarking:
- Open-model hosting economics are sensitive to model choice, sequence length, and batching.
- Ballpark: hosted managed open-models typically land between $8–15 per 1M tokens for production-grade latency; dedicated reserved capacity can push unit costs materially lower at scale (single-digit $/1M). We'll have Marissa follow up with a tighter comparison vs OpenAI/Anthropic and managed hosts.

I've attached our pricing sheet for context (redwood-pricing-sheet-v2.pdf).

Would you be available for a short alignment call Monday to confirm SOW scope and procurement expectations?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Jared Simmons <jared.simmons@acme.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@acme.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Pricing follow-up: token benchmarking & target price — initial benchmark numbers

Hi Jared / Vanessa — I pulled together an initial set of assumptions and a high-level $/1M comparison for the models and deployment modes we've discussed. Notes and caveats below; numbers are estimates for planning and will be validated in the PoC.

Assumptions (what a token means here):
- 1M tokens = 1,000,000 tokens roughly equivalent to ~750k–850k words depending on tokenization; we keep the same definition across hosts for consistency.
- Baseline response length: 128 tokens average per request for gen workloads.
- Embeddings billed separately; shown here as equivalent token cost for simplification on the summary line.
- Quantization: 4-bit/INT4 available on dedicated; reduces FLOPs and memory footprint materially.
- Batching: we assume 30–80ms additional latency headroom for batching at scale; we will tune to meet your latency SLO.

Initial $/1M token estimates (planning numbers):
- Redwood (hosted, curated open-model): $8 / 1M tokens
- Redwood (dedicated reserved capacity, committed): $3 / 1M tokens (at 30–50M/mo commit)
- OpenAI (equivalent closed model endpoints): $18–22 / 1M tokens (higher for latest closed LLMs)
- Anthropic (equivalent closed model endpoints): $16–20 / 1M tokens
- Managed open-model hosts (other providers): $10–12 / 1M tokens
- Self-hosted raw infra (customer-run on cloud, excludes ops): $4–7 / 1M tokens (wide variance by infra efficiency and ops overhead)

Key levers to hit $6–8 target:
1) Move to dedicated reserved capacity with 1–3 month commit — unit economics improve significantly.
2) Aggressive quantization (INT4) and model-selection tuning — can reduce cost ~20–40% vs FP16 inference.
3) KV/prefix caching for repeated context to avoid re-computation on common prefixes.
4) Workload engineering: reduce average generated tokens where possible (shorter prompts, more targeted outputs).

Recommended next step: run the 2-week PoC that measures baseline token counts and cost with our hosted models, then a dedicated pilot to validate committed pricing. I attached a draft PoC SOW for scope and deliverables (acme-poc-sow-v1.docx).

Estimate for procurement planning: to reach $3–4 / 1M tokens reliably you'd be looking at a committed dedicated arrangement at ~30M+/mo with quantization; to meet $6–8/1M we can likely achieve that with either hosted + optimizations or a modest dedicated commitment.

Happy to jump on a short call to walk through these numbers.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
From: Jared Simmons <jared.simmons@acme.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@acme.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up: token benchmarking & target price

Thanks, Marissa / Vanessa — this is exactly the level of detail we needed. A few quick points:
- Our procurement has earmarked a $50k/month budget for Q3 initial rollout contingent on validated PoC numbers.
- Target economics: we'd ideally see ~$6–7 / 1M tokens as a go/no-go for our execs. If Redwood can show a clear path to $3–4 / 1M at higher committed volumes that would be great to include in the roadmap.

Next steps from our side:
1) Please send an SOW + PoC timeline we can share with procurement.
2) We'll need a preliminary contract template for review (legal will want to see indemnities/SLA language up front).

I've attached a preliminary PO for internal planning (acme_po_rev1.pdf). Let's set the alignment call for Monday; Vanessa, can you propose times?

Appreciate it,
Jared
Director, AI Platforms
Acme Corp
